title: Fruits of life
description: Fruits of life will be a workpiece measuring 230 x 60 x 60 cm. The figurines form the heart of the composition and are approximately 13x6x6 cm in size.
context:
Fruits of life will be a workpiece measuring 230 x 60 x 60 cm. The figurines form the heart of the composition and are approximately 13x6x6 cm in size. Currently, the figurines include: The Water Bearer (2012), The Scale (2013), Mother and Child (2018), The Fisherman (2019), The Family (2021), Comforting (2023).

The figurines are placed in two ellipsoids, which hang from a curled long oak branch measuring 260 cm. At the base of the branch there is a triangular "wheel" to support it. Above that is a blossoming branch, consisting of 12 flowers, 10 flower buds, and several leaves (2025).
